contracts.parameter_matrix_convention: exp(-pi*(x-c)^2/v) and exp(-pi*x^T*C^-1*x); v and C are squared Gaussian parameters, not probability variances
contracts.rounding: Correctly-rounded directed rational conversion, pi, arithmetic and exp in MPFR/MPFI; argument clipping precedes extreme exponent computation. Uniform interval-width derivation is a project proof requiring independent review.
contracts.randomness: Independent uniform bytes for mathematical distances; frozen test-only SHAKE stream for reproducibility, not security evidence
contracts.quality_class: J=[R;I], ||R||_F^2<=Q, gamma integer>=2, sigma=(gamma+2)(Q+1); exact covariance and determinant proof, entire public class rejected if universal bit budget fails
contracts.path_scope: Every possible finite actual sampler history, not all unbounded ideal Gaussian histories; sequential coupling uses the uniform scalar bound on equal finite histories
contracts.fixed_tape: Full public-length byte tapes per SampleD and disjoint full parent bands per delegation column; enough bytes on every admitted finite path; no entropy fallback or resampling
contracts.finite_PMF_scope: Normalized scalar accepted kernels and sequential accepted-kernel vector law, not the actual vector distribution conditioned on whole-vector success
contracts.sign: R_id=-R_delegated, user SampleD receives R=R_delegated; tested at odd q
contracts.generated_quality_probability_claim: Observed 3/3 qualifications only; negligible failure probabilities and complete finite security ledger remain WIP
